summary: Qtrex Quantum Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement (PIPE) with a single institutional investor, issuing 3,895,000 ordinary shares at $1.50/share and pre-funded warrants for up to 2,771,667 shares at $1.4999/warrant, raising $10M gross. The warrants are exercisable immediately at $0.0001/share with a 9.99% beneficial ownership limit. Board recommendation is not stated; A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as placement agent receiving 7.0% cash fee. Proceeds used for working capital; the company agreed to a 30-day lockup on further issuances. Registration rights require filing Form F-3 within 5 trading days. This is a seasoned equity offering (SEO) typically classified as capital return.
